import subprocess, hashlib, os

os.chdir('/workspace/repo')

def gitb(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git']+list(args), capture_output=True).stdout

def sha1(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\x00'+data).hexdigest()

subprocess.run(['git','hash-object','-w','--stdin'], input=usage_red, check=True)

def make_tree(entries):
    lines = ''
    for mode,typ,sha,name in entries:
        lines += mode+' '+typ+' '+sha+'\t'+name+'\n'
    r = subprocess.run(['git','mktree','--batch'], input=lines.encode(), capture_output=True, check=True)
    return r.stdout.decode().split()[0]

app_sha = gitb('rev-parse','6d21507:config/app.toml').strip().decode()
config_tree = make_tree([('100644','blob',app_sha,'app.toml')])
readme = gitb('rev-parse','6d21507:README.md').strip().decode()
parser = gitb('rev-parse','6d21507:parser.py').strip().decode()
tree_6d = make_tree([('100644','blob',readme,'README.md'),('040000','tree',config_tree,'config'),('100644','blob',parser,'parser.py')])
docs_tree = make_tree([('100644','blob',usage_red_sha,'USAGE.md')])
tree_d8 = make_tree([('100644','blob',readme,'README.md'),('040000','tree',config_tree,'config'),('040000','tree',docs_tree,'docs'),('100644','blob',parser,'parser.py')])
tree_9b = tree_d8

tree_1c = tree_d8

def write_commit(orig_sha, new_tree, new_parents):
    raw = gitb('cat-file','-p',orig_sha)
    out=[]
    for ln in raw.split(b'\n'):
        if ln.startswith(b'tree '):
            out.append(b'tree '+new_tree.encode())
        elif ln.startswith(b'parent '):
            out.append(b'parent '+new_parents.pop(0).encode())
        else:
            out.append(ln)
    body = b'\n'.join(out)
    h = hashlib.sha1(b'commit '+str(len(body)).encode()+b'\x00'+body).hexdigest()
    subprocess.run(['git','hash-object','-w','--stdin','-t','commit'], input=body, check=True)
    return h
